profile.headline: Software Engineer at Dina
profile.summary: Full stack web developer with a passion for accessibility, education, and music.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Iterated on Dina’s website that facilitates transitions of patients, documents episodes, text screenings of patients and care coordinators, and insights that predict and prevent ER visits
- Developed SMART on FHIR integrations with EMRs such as Epic and Cerner
- Spearheaded frontend app rewrite effort to modernize web app with React and Expo 
- Collaborated with product managers to task out new features in the healthcare space, including patient choice, bundled referrals, and transitionist stakeholder use cases.
- Worked with data warehouse analyst to create an audit trail of user interactions via BigQuery
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Progressive Web Applications (PWAs) · React.js

positions.title: Private Lessons Teacher
positions.description:
- Piano and flute teacher for children ages 8-14
- Focus instruction on theory & musicality

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a freelance designer to revamp website homepage and create a two-part campaign page for Illumina Color, the company’s line of hair dye using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
- Adapted campaign page to be hosted on MyNavi, a Japanese social media network that runs on PHP
- Added animations and lazy loading on both the campaign page and website, creating a more interactive user experience

positions.title: Front End Software Developer
positions.description:
- Iterated on public facing websites, including contact forms, dev docs, and marketing site that involved multiple codebases written in Node, React, and Ruby
- Collaborated with different teams within the organization including docs contributors, support, marketing, and product managers on new features, automation, and bug fixes
- Incorporated SEO, automation, UTM tracking into the websites to assist marketing team in collecting data they needed for leads
- Spearheaded effort to update websites to be compliant with WCAG AA Accessibility standards and presented on progress at an internal conference
- Wrote automated unit and integration tests using Cypress, Capybara + Selenium, Chai + Mocha
- Developed a custom search for marketing site and dev docs using Algolia’s search as a service to create a more streamlined experience for users
- Initiated an app to document Braintree’s new GraphQL API using Node and Gatsby, a static site generator that uses React
- Built Braintree’s support contact form that sends tickets to Zendesk and handled spam protection via Google’s ReCaptcha and Nginx

positions.title: Product Designer
positions.description:
- Created a company-wide design system for a cohesive visual brand by being part of internal CSS and shared frontend components working groups
- Conducted user research with interaction tracking and AB testing to learn more about our users and how Braintree products can better serve them
- Designed comps in Sketch and Figma while rotating across different product teams
- Implemented designs with SASS and client-side Javascript

positions.title: Contributor
positions.description:
- fix bugs reported by members and submit pull requests for review
- work off Mozilla’s open source repository, Bedrock, using git

positions.title: Front End Development Intern, Team Lead
positions.description:
- using git, worked in a team to develop Nebrhood, a social media platform that allows users to connect with local politicians and fellow citizens
- promoted to team lead after 2 months and held meetings/conference calls in supervisor’s absence
- using Play Framework, created/managed views and connected views to back-end with java, scala templates, and dust.js
- main graphic and user experience designer

positions.title: Freelance Technologist
positions.description:
- work with the heads of the collective in various web projects and art installations
- FOOL: touch and keydown animation using graphics and sounds by artist Edwin
   Bolta and developed using SVGs, jQuery/Javascript, and audio sprites
- PRIME: commerce site powered by Wordpress

projects.title: Foodie.share
projects.description: A food share app built with Ruby on Rails and Vue.js that allows users to order food from each other, private kitchens, and established businesses without storefronts. Chefs are able to post dishes with prices, pictures, and a description, organize dishes into menu categories, set opening hours and days, and text patrons delivery information, automated via the Twilio app. Patrons can search for dishes by cuisine and dietary restrictions, add dishes to a shopping cart, choose between delivery or takeout, and check out with their credit card. Payment processing will be handled with the Stripe API.

projects.title: Girls Who Code Student/Alumini Directory
projects.description: The Girls Who Code Student/Alumini Directory was the 2015 IAM Team capstone project. Over the course of 15 weeks the class built GWC a Wordpress based directory using Buddypress for member management and a fully customized theme using the Responsive theme as a base. I worked main with the Wordpress development team adding and customizing plugins and customizing user profile options.
